notes.title: Driver Booster 4 Update - New V4.5.0 is live!
notes.content:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/545110/Driver_Booster_4_for_Steam/
Hi Guys,

New improvements for you to keep more important drivers up-to-date with higher scanning speed.

+ Expanded driver database to support updating more devices like AMD EPYC, AMD Radeon RX Vega, and Intel Xeon Scalabe.
+ Optimized scan engine for safer and faster scan.
+ Optimized program's installation process.
+ Fixed known bugs.
